description: Main application source file for Bluetooth peripheral with HID support, handling Bluetooth initialization, connection, security, and advertising.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Handles Bluetooth connection event, sets security, logs connection status.

methods.name: disconnected
methods.description: Handles Bluetooth disconnection event, logs disconnection reason.

methods.name: security_changed
methods.description: Handles security level change or failure, logs security status.

methods.name: bt_ready
methods.description: Callback for Bluetooth initialization, starts advertising.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point, initializes Bluetooth, registers callbacks, starts HID button loop.
